Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek

move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You close by heading back to the machines—it sounds like keeping this discussion practical and brief matters to you. We want a clear, competitive agreement without unnecessary back-and-forth. How could flexibility on payment timing and delivery lead time help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,
got your mail, thanks.
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €15.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP.
Straight answer:
We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.
Hallo, you asked about payment timing - if you pay in 14 days, that helps us buy material and I can do €15.80.
I can agree to DAP and the 42 days lead time you asked for.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €15.70 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.
Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.
With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium.
We have free capacity for your parts.
Back to the machines now.
Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
